newsitem.title: USA: Ethyl says CFO Walker to step down.
newsitem.headline: Ethyl says CFO Walker to step down.

text.p: Ethyl Corp said Friday that Charles Walker, its vice chairman, chief financial officer and treasurer, intends to relinquish his positions as CFO and treasurer on October 1.
He will be replaced by J. Robert Mooney, who is managing partner at the Richmond office of the accounting firm Coopers & Lybrand LLP, the company said.
Mooney will also assume the title of senior vice president of Ethyl and become a member of the company's management committee on October 1.

The company said that by stepping down as CFO and treasurer, Walker would be able to devote his full time to Albemarle Corp, which was spun off from Ethyl in 1994. Since that time, Walker had served in dual roles as CFO for both companies.
Ethyl said Walker's transition to Albemarle will be completed by year-end. He will continue to be a director at Ethyl, it said.
